notes: A line starting with ! is replaced whole by the descriptor's last_input, trailing text ignored; ! never changes last_input. Found in Zach's playtest 2026-10-15 ("Huh?!"); removing the history step restores Huh?!? (R1/R2/R5h).
^old^new replaces the first occurrence of old in last_input and the result becomes last_input; strstr finds an empty old at position 0 and the result is bounded by MAX_INPUT_LENGTH (R1/R5h).
A missing second ^ or an old that last_input lacks sends Invalid substitution. and queues nothing (R1/R5h).
